subject: KwikLogistics vendor intake — compliance gate forms and PO routing
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@kwiklogistics.com>

Cc: KwikLogistics Procurement <procurement@kwiklogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor intake — security docs, PO path, and onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier — excited to get Redwood set up for a pilot. Procurement asked me to collect the mandatory compliance artifacts so we can open a PO and route payment. Specifically they asked for the following:

- Executed DPA (or DPA template we can review)
- SOC 2 Type II report or a link to a hosted read-only copy
- Current subprocessor list (including cloud providers and managed partners)
- Remit/invoice address and any PO instructions (email or vendor portal link)

Can you also confirm expected lead time for PO issuance (our internal SLAs vary by legal review and finance signoff)? We’ll try to move quickly but would like to set expectations.

If easier, we can upload docs to your vendor portal — let me know the preferred path.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Procurement Manager | KwikLogistics
Sara.Liu@kwiklogistics.com
+1 415-555-0187

Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security docs, PO path, and onboarding

Hi Sara — great to meet you.

Thanks for outlining the asks. Per our procurement checklist, I’m including the minimum package to unblock PO issuance and vendor activation below — I’ve attached the DPA template and current subprocessor list; SOC 2 is hosted (link included).

Checklist / next steps:
1) DPA: attached PDF is the standard Redwood DPA (signed stub for your review). If legal needs redlines, send them back and Monica will coordinate.
2) SOC 2 Type II: read-only link (we host via secure Drive) — short cover note can be provided on request. See link in related_links.
3) Subprocessor list: attached CSV lists current processors (GCP, S3 storage partner, analytics vendor). If you need a breakout by region, say which jurisdiction(s) matter and I’ll pull details.
4) PO & invoice routing: preferred is upload to vendor portal (URL in related_links) OR email PO to billing@redwood.ai. Please include Redwood Tax ID: 98-7654321 and our remit address below.

Remit / invoice address (please use EXACT text on PO):
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attn: Accounts Receivable
1201 Market St, Suite 302
San Francisco, CA 94103
United States

Billing contact for questions: invoices@redwood.ai (cc Evelyn Hart)

Typical internal lead time: once we receive a clean PO + executed DPA (or confirmation of DPA review), we normally provision billing and customer access within 2 business days. If there are contract redlines that require legal review, that can extend to 5-10 business days depending on complexity.

If helpful, I can 1) open a vendor portal intake ticket for KwikLogistics, and 2) route a purchase-order acceptance acknowledgement back to you once the PO is received.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_signed_stub.pdf, redwood-subprocessor-list-2027-06.csv

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Subject: Re: Vendor intake — security docs, PO path, and onboarding

Thanks, Karthik — that helps a lot. A couple quick follow-ups from our security and finance teams:

- Subprocessors: can you confirm whether backups/data-at-rest are managed by your cloud provider (GCP) and whether any EU-region data would be stored outside the EU? The security reviewer asked for a short line on residency for EU customers.
- SOC 2: procurement is OK with the hosted PDF link, but security sometimes asks for a one-paragraph cover letter stating the reporting period and that the report is the latest Type II. Can Redwood provide that?
- Invoice / remit: please use the following billing name/address on the PO (we will route internally):

KwikLogistics Inc.
Accounts Payable
Remit to: KwikLogistics, AP Services
123 Harbor Rd
Oakland, CA 94607

We will aim to issue PO by end of week; Michael will shepherd this internally. If you can provide the SOC 2 cover note and confirm residency wording, we’ll attach both to the PO packet.

Sara
